update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.76 - Crash Reporting, Aptitude Heatmap, and Run Comparison
Added ----- - In-app crash/error reporting tab to review uncaught render errors without pulling device logs. - Aptitude heatmap across archived Career Runs showing distance/surface/running-style grades. - Run comparison view to select archived runs and compare stats, aptitude, quality/fans, and epithet outcomes side by side. - Browser notification toggle on the live log viewer page that fires when a run/session completes. - Auto-borrow support card wiring for the friend-list borrow picker.
Fixed ----- - Legacy parent factor-based selection scoring bugs. - Auto-select/confirm dialogs and final-confirmation Start Career could retry indefinitely on repeated detection failures; now bounded with a fixed retry cap before giving up.
